book.name: 1 KORINTUS
book.title: SURANA PAULUS MOBHAA-BHAANA TO JAMAʼA I KORINTUS

content: Pamembaliakumo sandarana karomiu, apokana uka mboomo iaku kupamembali Al Masi o sandarana karoku.
Katutubhina Bhaana Bhawine
Iaku kupujikomiu, roonamo ingkomiu sadia uudhaniaku i nuncana bhari-bharia giu, tee sadhaadhaa utaʼatia o kaadhari mopadhana ipakawaakaku to ingkomiu.
Maka iaku gauku bhekupaumbaakakomiu ande o Al Masi satotuuna mokapalaina bhari-bharia umane, apokana uka tee samia umane mokapalaina bhawine, tee o Aulataʼala mokapalaina Al Masi.
Bhari-bharia umane motutubhina bhaana wakutuuna adoʼa atawa wakutuuna apakawaaka kasameana Aulataʼala, sumaimo incia ahina Al Masi.
Maka bhari-bharia bhawine inda motutubhina bhaana wakutuuna adoʼa atawa wakutuuna apakawaaka kasameana Aulataʼala, satotuuna incia ahina umanena,
roonamo soo apokanamo tee agunti buluana.

Ande dhaangia o bhawine inda motutubhina bhaana, salabhina aguntia apepadhaia o buluana. Maka ande dhaangia o bhawine moguntina buluana atawa mokuruina buluana sumai aabhia amembali saangu hali motomaeaaka, sumaimo incia tabeana atutubhia o bhaana.
Umane inda alaenga atutubhia o bhaana, roonamo incia amembali gambarana tee kaogesana Aulataʼala, maka o bhawine amembali kaogesana umane,
roonamo umane inda aminaaka i bhawine, maka o bhawine mominaakana i umane.
Tee o umane atopadhaangia mencuana to bhawine, maka o bhawine atopadhaangia to umane.
Tee mamudhaakana uhoromati manga malaaʼekati mokamatana ibaadatimiu, bhawine awaajibu apake katutubhina bhaa to tandana ande incia akapalaia umanena.
Moomini mboo sumai i nuncana dhadhita tamembali mia moosena Kawasana Oputa Momalanga, bhawine inda amembali apogaa tee umane, tee o umane inda amembali apogaa tee bhawine.
Roonamo apokana tee bhawine aminaaka i umane, mboomo uka umane apalaahiria bhawine; tee bhari-bharia asalana aminaaka i Aulataʼala.
Coba ufikiria o giu incia sii: Buaka alaenga samia bhawine adoʼa i Aulataʼala inda apake katutubhina bhaa?
Amembalimo saangu kaadhari tee giu imatauna mia bhari, ande o umane momaaratena buluana amembali saangu giu motomaeaaka.
Maka to bhawine, bulua adhawuakea to atutubhiaka bhaana, tee o bulua maarate amembali saangu kaogesa ibanggaaka.
Ande dhaangia o mia mopobantaakana giu incia sumai, sumaimo ingkami inda tee kananeamami to tapewau mboo sumai, tee uka manga jamaʼana Aulataʼala inda tee kananeana mboo sumai!
Kananea Mosala i Wakutuuna Kariaa Momangkilo to Taudhani Matena Isa
To pokaiana tee giu ipogauakaku sii, iaku inda kupujikomiu, roonamo poromuamiu wakutuuna uʼibaadati inda aumbaaka kalape, maka aumbaaka kadhaki.
Bhaa-bhaana irangoku wakutuuna uporomu-romu, ingkomiu inda uposaangu tee jamaʼamiu tee utobage amembali pia kolompo. Iaku sagaamea kuparacaea ande o lele incia sii atotuu.
Roonamo i tanga-tangamiu dhaanamo bheupogaa-gaa, mamudhaakana atokamata manga mia mototuu-totuuna tee mompuu-mpuuna moparacaeana Kawasana Opu.
Tee moomini uka uporomu, ingkomiu inda uporomuaka to ukande kinandena kariaa momangkilona Kawasana Opu.
Roonamo akawa o wakutuuna ukande, bhari-bharikomiu ukande kinandemiu porikana, sabutuna dhaangia sagaa inda mopotibhaakana kinande, sainamo mosagaanana amalango.

Buaka ingkomiu inda tee bhanuamiu to ukande tee usumpu? Pokia ingkomiu upandaʼente jamaʼana Aulataʼala tee uhaejati to upekaea manga mia momisikini? Bholi upewau mboo sumai! Jadi opea momembalina ipogauakaku to ingkomiu? Amembali buaka kupujikomiu i nuncana giu incia sii? Inda! Atantumo iaku inda sampeampearo bhekupujikomiu.
Opea mopadhana itarimaku minaaka i Isa Oputa Momalanga, giumo incia sumai iadhariakaku uka to ingkomiu, siitumo i malona Isa Oputa Momalanga atohianati, Incia aala roti,
tee sapadhana aemani sukuru i Aulataʼala, aweta-wetamea o rotina sumai tee apogau, "Siimo badaku ipasaraakaaka to ingkomiu. Pewaumea o giu incia sii to uudhaniaka Iaku."

Sapadhana akande tee cara mopokana Incia aalamo tonde tee apogau, "Tonde incia sii satotuuna o pojanjia bhaau motomateraiakana tee raaku. Pewaumea o giu incia sii to uudhaniaka Iaku gagari wakutuuna usumpua."
Jadi gagari ingkomiu ukande roti tee usumpu angguru minaaka i tondena kariaa sumai, maʼanana apokanamo tee upakoleleaka mateana Isa Oputa Momalanga sakawana Incia aumba pendua.

Rampaakanamo sumai, incema mokandena roti tee mosumpuna angguru minaaka i tondena kariaa momangkilo to taudhani matena Isa tee cara inda molaenga, sumaimo incia bheakodosa tee Oputa Momalanga mopadhana mokurubaniakana badana tee raana.
Jadi, bhari-bharia mia tabeana parakisaa karona, kasiimpo amembali akande roti tee asumpu angguru minaaka i tonde sumai.
Roonamo incema-incema mokandena roti tee mosumpuna angguru, maka inda aʼakui badana Al Masi, sumaimo incia apokanamo tee aumbaaka kahukumu to karona.
Rampaakanamo sumai abhari minaaka i tanga-tangamiu momalutena tee momapiina, tee sampe abhari uka momatena.
Maka ande aporikana taparakisaa karota, sumaimo ingkita inda bhetapotibhaaka kahukumu.
Maka ande mangahukumu Kawasana Opu, sumaimo Incia bheamangaadhari mamudhaakana inda tatohukumu tee dunia sii.
E manga witinaiku, rampaakanamo sumai, wakutuuna uporomu-romu to ukande i kariaa momangkilo to taudhani matena Isa, ingkomiu tabeana upoantaantagi tee witinaimiu.

Ande dhaangia o mia monamisina kaara, salabhina akandepo porikana i bhanuana mamudhaakana o poromu-romuana ibaadatimiu sumai inda aumbaaka kahukumu to ingkomiu. Sainamo to hali mosagaanana kuumbapo kasiimpo kuʼatoroa.
